stem: How were Harry Burt and the man who created the ice-cream cone similar?

options.label: F
options.text: They both got ideas for their inventions from others.

options.label: G
options.text: They both sold their frozen treats at a fair.

options.label: H
options.text: They both used waffles to hold their frozen treats.

options.label: J
options.text: They developed their inventions during the same year.
